display.title: Table 14.2.3 Best overall response
head: ONK-44 400 mg
Docetaxel
footnotes: Independent review and investigator agreed on whether a participant responded for 41 of 42 participants (97.6%).

Best overall response from the RECIST 1.1 overall responses up to progression; stable disease counts only if assessed at least 5 weeks after randomisation; responses need no confirmation in this randomised study. 95% CI for each rate by the Clopper-Pearson method; for the difference, a Wald interval.

methods.name: Table 14.1.1: disposition at the data cut-off (randomised participants)
methods.description: SCREENED and SCRFAIL (Total, n); POP N; TREATED, PFSEVT, DEATH, ALIVE: n and pct of randomised.

methods.name: Table 14.1.2: demographics (intent-to-treat population)
methods.description: AGE: n, mean, sd, median, min, max; AGEGR1, SEX, RACE, COUNTRY: n and pct by category.

methods.name: Table 14.2.1: progression-free survival by independent review (primary endpoint)
methods.description: PFS: n per group; PFS_EVT and PFS_CNS: n and pct (CNSR 0 and 1). PFS_MED est, lcl, ucl in months (days / 30.4375): Kaplan-Meier median; 95% CI by Brookmeyer-Crowley with log(-log) limits; a limit that is not reached is left out (NE). PFS_HR est, lcl, ucl for ONK-44 against docetaxel: lab_cox(AVAL, 1 - CNSR, ONK indicator), Breslow ties. PFS_P p: unstratified log-rank test with the hypergeometric variance (1 df).

methods.name: Table 14.2.2: progression-free survival by the investigator (sensitivity analysis)
methods.description: PFSINV: n per group; PFSINV_EVT and PFSINV_CNS: n and pct (CNSR 0 and 1). PFSINV_MED est, lcl, ucl in months (days / 30.4375): Kaplan-Meier median; 95% CI by Brookmeyer-Crowley with log(-log) limits; a limit that is not reached is left out (NE). PFSINV_HR est, lcl, ucl for ONK-44 against docetaxel: lab_cox(AVAL, 1 - CNSR, ONK indicator), Breslow ties. PFSINV_P p: unstratified log-rank test with the hypergeometric variance (1 df).

methods.name: Table 14.2.3: best overall response (RECIST 1.1)
methods.description: N; IRC_BOR and INV_BOR n and pct by category; IRC_ORR and INV_ORR n and pct; *_ORRCI lcl and ucl (binom.test, Clopper-Pearson, in %); *_DIFF est, lcl, ucl (ONK-44 minus docetaxel, Wald, in %); AGREE n and pct (Total).

methods.name: Table 14.2.4: overall survival (secondary endpoint, interim)
methods.description: OS: n per group; OS_EVT and OS_CNS: n and pct (CNSR 0 and 1). OS_MED est, lcl, ucl in months (days / 30.4375): Kaplan-Meier median; 95% CI by Brookmeyer-Crowley with log(-log) limits; a limit that is not reached is left out (NE). OS_HR est, lcl, ucl for ONK-44 against docetaxel: lab_cox(AVAL, 1 - CNSR, ONK indicator), Breslow ties. OS_P p: unstratified log-rank test with the hypergeometric variance (1 df).

methods.name: Table 14.3.5: extent of exposure (safety population)
methods.description: TRTDURD for the safety population: n, mean, sd, median, min, max.

methods.name: Table 14.3.2: overview of treatment-emergent adverse events (safety population)
methods.description: POP N; ANY, REL (AEREL "RELATED"), GR3 (ATOXGRN >= 3), SER, SERREL, DISC (AEACN "DRUG WITHDRAWN"), MOD ("DRUG INTERRUPTED" or "DOSE REDUCED"), FATAL (ATOXGRN 5) on TRTEMFL "Y": participants n and pct; DEATH: ADSL DTHFL "Y", n and pct.

methods.name: Table 14.3.1: treatment-emergent adverse events by system class and preferred term
methods.description: POP N; ANY; SOC (CATEGORY = AEBODSYS); PT (CATEGORY "<AEBODSYS> | <AEDECOD>"): participants n and pct.

methods.name: Table 14.3.3: treatment-emergent adverse events of grade 3 or higher by preferred term
methods.description: POP N; ANY and PT (CATEGORY = AEDECOD) on TRTEMFL "Y" and ATOXGRN >= 3: participants n and pct.
